title: Reve de Mer 1 Lockoff Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Reve De Mer 1 Lockoff is a 1 BR / 1.5 BA / 3 Guest cottage in Seaside, FL. The Reve de Mer: 1 Bedroom Lock-off offers all of the amenities that a solo traveler, couple, or small family needs to enjoy a stunning Seaside vacation.
description_expanded: Description102 Savannah Street1 KING, 1 TWIN* Construction Notice - Third-party construction is occurring on an adjacent lot across from this residence and may be visible or audible during permitted hours. In Seaside, Florida, construction hours are Monday–Saturday, 8 AM–6 PM. Please contact the Homeowner’s Collection team at 1-855-411-1557 to inquire on construction details. Prime Seaside Location Near Beach, Pools & Fitness CenterReve de Mer: 1 Bedroom Lock-off is the perfect Seaside, Florida retreat for a solo traveler, couple, or small family seeking comfort, convenience, and classic coastal charm. Ideally located just steps from a Seaside swimming pool, fitness center, and neighborhood green space—and only moments from the sugar-white sand beach—this inviting cottage places the very best of Seaside right outside your door. Enjoy leisurely picnics at the nearby park, sunny afternoons by the pool, and effortless walks to the beach for a truly relaxing coastal escape.Screened Porches & Outdoor LivingA spacious screened-in front porch sets the tone for laid-back Seaside living, offering the perfect spot to unwind at any time of day. Sip a glass of wine on the porch swing, relax in the rocking chairs, or enjoy the gentle Gulf breeze as the day winds down. Around back, a screened porch provides an additional outdoor dining space, ideal for enjoying meals al fresco or lingering over morning coffee.Comfortable Living Spaces & Coastal StyleInside, double glass doors open to a welcoming interior with a thoughtfully designed open floor plan. The living room has been newly furnished for comfort and relaxation, complete with a flat-screen TV, DVD player, and high-speed WiFi—perfect for movie nights or quiet evenings in after a day at the beach.Fully Equipped Kitchen & Grilling AreaThe well-appointed kitchen offers everything needed for a home-away-from-home experience, making it easy to prepare casual breakfasts or full dinners. Take meals outside to the screened porch or fire up the gas grill to cook locally caught seafood before heading out to enjoy Seaside’s dining and entertainment scene.Restful Bedrooms & Thoughtful DetailsAt the end of the day, retreat to the re-furnished primary bedroom, which offers ample closet and storage space along with a charming window seat—an inviting spot to read, relax, or enjoy a quiet morning coffee. A cozy twin bedroom and convenient half bathroom on the first floor provide flexible sleeping arrangements for additional guests or children.A Relaxing Seaside EscapeFrom listening to the nearby waves in the private outdoor shower to enjoying board games, beach days, and sunset strolls, Reve de Mer: 1 Bedroom Lock-off delivers everything needed for a memorable Seaside vacation. With its unbeatable location, inviting outdoor spaces, and comfortable interiors, this charming cottage is an ideal home base for experiencing the best of Seaside, Florida.Not available during peak season. * 3 night minimum Spring, Spring Break, Summer, and 2 night minimum Fall & Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. FEATURES Seaside Private Residential Beach at Savannah Pavilion2-minute walk, 176 yards to beach accessTwo enclosed outdoor showersLarge, gourmet-equipped kitchen featuring Calphalon & All-Clad cookwareWiFi throughout the homeTwo large LCD TVs with premium cable channelsCeiling fans in every roomLarge screened front porch with rocking chairsScreened outdoor dining patio off the kitchen with gas grillPeacock Alley Linens – fresh, luxurious towels and sheets throughout the homeAccess to Seaside amenities, including 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts (court fees apply), 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedOne parking pass issued for one-bedroom cottagesA golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permit.No pets allowedSTR23-002374
